data.name: Violence of Action
data.detailed_description:
Violence of Action is a hybrid real-time tactics game where strategic command, tactical planning, and direct combat come together on a constantly changing battlefield.

Lead your forces from the command view, pause the action to coordinate complex maneuvers, or instantly take direct control of any infantry soldier or vehicle to execute the mission yourself. Switch seamlessly between commanding the battle and fighting on the front line whenever the situation demands it.

Every engagement is built around momentum. Suppress enemy positions, breach defenses, exploit breakthroughs, and keep pushing forward before the enemy has time to recover. Success comes from maintaining the initiative, adapting to changing conditions, and turning every advantage into the next objective.

The battlefield itself is a weapon. Buildings collapse, walls crumble, cover disappears, and new paths are created through destruction. Every explosion can reshape the terrain, forcing both sides to constantly adapt their tactics and opening opportunities that didn't exist moments before.

Fight across a procedurally generated strategic campaign where every operation shapes the course of the war. Capture territory, research new equipment, expand your arsenal, and build a force capable of overcoming increasingly difficult missions. No two campaigns unfold exactly the same, offering new maps, objectives, and tactical challenges with every playthrough.

Key Features

  • Hybrid gameplay combining real-time tactics, tactical pause, and direct control.

  • Instantly take command of any infantry soldier or vehicle in top-down action combat.

  • Seamlessly switch between battlefield command and direct combat at any time.

  • Coordinate multi-squad assaults using a powerful tactical pause system.

  • Highly destructible environments that dynamically reshape cover, sightlines, and movement.

  • Lead infantry and armored vehicles in combined arms warfare.

  • Procedurally generated strategic campaign with evolving battlefields and high replayability.

  • Research new equipment and technologies to customize your fighting force.

  • Every battle rewards planning, adaptation, and maintaining the initiative.

Plan. Push. Adapt. Victory belongs to the commander who never gives the enemy a chance to recover.

data.short_description: Command squads in real time, pause to coordinate complex assaults, or instantly take direct control of any soldier or vehicle. Fight across destructible battlefields in a procedurally generated World War II-inspired tactical campaign.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super (6 GB) / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 (10 GB) / AMD RX 7900 GRE
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of military combat, including blood, dismemberment, and other acts of violence. Due to the game's stylized presentation and small-scale units, these effects are limited and non-photorealistic. The game does not contain extreme gore or graphic depictions of violence.
